name: leadline-profile
brief: Build the Leadline profile and initial rating of one user (a startup or an investor) from what they filled in, the Cala facts given in cala_facts, and web research. Profile fields: website, description, country, stage (startup), stages and check_size (investor), sectors, lead_share and last_lead_date (investor: share of its rounds it led, last lead). Keep every fact you use in profile.facts (id, kind dataset or web, ref or url, quote, date) and give each non-null field a sources entry: the fact ids, or inferred: true. Rating: parts in [0, 1] (e.g. fit, traction, team, activity) and total, with fact ids. When current and update are given, revise that profile: change only what the update or new evidence supports and list each change in changes with field, old, new and reason; otherwise changes is empty.

seed_tendencies.text: Start from cala_facts and the user's own fields; use web research to confirm them or fill gaps, and cite the page you read.
A field you cannot support is null. Mark a field inferred only when it follows from cited facts (e.g. sectors from the product description).
When as_of is given, ignore every fact dated after it, including web pages about later rounds.
On an update, keep every field the update and new evidence do not touch exactly as it was; never drop a sourced field without a change entry that says why.
Rate each part from evidence: fit (clarity of sector and stage), traction (rounds, customers), team, activity (recent rounds or leads); total is the mean of the parts.
